stem: Indira reads a map with representative fraction $1 : 40{,}000$. The measured map distance between two temples is $5\,\mathrm{cm}$.

parts.text: What is the actual ground distance?
Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: One centimetre on the map stands for $40{,}000\,\mathrm{cm}$ on the ground, so $5\,\mathrm{cm}$ stands for $200{,}000\,\mathrm{cm}$, which is $2\,\mathrm{km}$.

teacher.key_rationale: RF 1:40000 means 1 cm map = 40000 cm ground = 0.4 km; times 5 gives 2 km. Reading 5 km or 40 km confuses map length or the RF digits with ground distance.
